fields.description: Program Description 1.Program Brief Introduction Editor Note: Students will gain strong abilities in the areas of engineering application and technological innovation. Students on this program will learn fundamental theories of mechanical design, micro-electronic technology, fluid transmission and control technology, computer technology, and information processing technology etc. The program aims to cultivate qualified personnel who have a solid foundation in math and mechanics, and interdisciplinary knowledge of mechatronics, electronics, control and computer technology etc. 2. Teaching Objective Editor Note: This program aims to foster high-level technical professionals with strong ability to solve problems. This program mainly focus on fundamental theory of mechanical design, Microelectronics technology, fluid drive and control technology, the basic knowledge of computer technology and information processing technology. This program cultivates specialists who are proficient in the knowledge of mechanical and electrical hydraulic control, and have fundamental knowledge in the field of major program and professional knowledge of related field. The graduation students would be high-level technical professionals with scientific thinking manner and creative thoughts. 3. Why choose to study this program? Editor Note: Students will be trained to be practical technicians to adapt to the fiercely competitive world. This major is designed to cultivate international practical technical personnel with: Basic principles and knowledge about modern mechanical & electronic technology; Practical skills needed in mechanical designing & mechanical manufacturing; Operating of digital control processing. 4. Main Courses Editor Note: Students will have 8 main courses to study this program. Engineering Mechanics Mechanical Design Mechanical Manufacturing Electrical and Electronic Technology Mechanical Engineering Materials Fundamentals of Manufacturing Technology Digital Control Technology CAD/CAM Technology You can download the newest curriculum here >> 5. Internship and Career Development Editor Note: Graduates generally work as product or management service provider. Graduates are prepared for employment in: Product design, product manufacturing, digital control programming and equipment maintenance in related enterprises. Business management and technology management etc. 6. Further Study Editor Note: After the undergraduate study, students take an advantage to pursue a master degree in various fields. Graduates could apply for a master degree in the leading technological areas such as mechanical and electronic engineering, mechanical design and theory, vehicle engineering, material processing and control engineering, machine design, manufacturing and automation, etc. One third of the undergraduates can be admitted to master degree programs, since those who have excellent performance during undergraduate study can be excused from examination and directly go on postgraduate study. 7. School Introduction Editor Note: One of the best engineering university in China. Shandong University of Science and Technolog y (SDUST), a key university of Shandong Province with distinct features, founded in 1951, is a multi-disciplinary university, offering comprehensive education in engineering, sciences, management, humanities, law, economics and education while giving prominence to engineering and the integration of science and engineering. Learn More >> 8. College of International Exchange Editor Note: The College is able to offer the best education in cutting-edge disciplines to international students around the world. The College of International Exchange at Shandong University of Science and Technology (SDUST), established in 2007, is an administrative institution for the education of international students, and promotion of the Chinese language and international cooperative education programs, etc. The College attaches great importance to the quality of teaching, and has conducted an all-round innovation in its teaching philosophy, its program delivery model and its management strategies. Ever since its establishment, the number of international students has been on a rapid increase. The College organizes a variety of campus activities for international students each year, including a New Year's party, Graduation Party, Chinese Language Proficiency Competition, Photography Contest, and sports, etc. 9. Campus Life Editor Note: By experiencing Chinese life and culture, international students enjoy themselves a lot. Chinese Traditional Handicraft Aesthetic Experience Ceramic Art Experience Activity

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included * 2. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 3. English proficiency test certificate For applicants whose first language is not English, a minimum score of IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 80 is required. * 4. Senior high school Certificate/diploma or A Level Certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 5. Senior high school academic transcript or A level transcripts Academic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 6. Resume You MUST fill the form provided by school. You can download a template or sample from here . * 7. Bank Statement * 8. Physical examination record for foreigner * 9. Introduce yourself video About 3-5 minutes. It should include the following information at least: -- A brief introduction,which should include your personal information, your family background, your guardian, your hobby, your awards chieved if have, and some other information you want us to know; -- What is your reason to study in China and apply to our university; -- How do you come to know our university; -- The future study plan, if you are a master or PHD applicants, you should say more about this part; -- Do you have any experience living or studying in China? If have, what impressed you most? -- Have you visited China before? Have you learned Chinese before? If you learned, which level you have reached? * 10. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
